aboutGame.title: What is Anomalous Coffee Machine?
paragraphs: Anomalous Coffee Machine is a short indie visual novel with interactive simulation elements, developed by HoruBrain and distributed through itch.io. You stand behind the counter, serve a mysterious girl, and discover that every word you type or ingredient you pour changes how she reacts — and which ending you reach.

The machine ignores normal cafe rules: it reads language instead of a fixed menu, and it rewards observation far more than speed. Across 700+ words, 600+ transformations, and 200+ animated scenes, every run is a short, repeatable vignette built for curious players who want to see every strange outcome.

modules.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine Guide
modules.description: Follow the full gameplay loop step by step, from starting a fresh file and reading the opening scene to brewing cups and restarting for new branches.

highlights.detail: Start a fresh file so you can see exactly what changes on each run.
Read the opening scene in full; the first lines often hide a hint.
Pick your response deliberately instead of clicking straight through.
Watch her reaction — pauses and tone shifts are the real feedback.
Brew at the machine and note anything that feels slightly off.
Finish the run, then restart; the second pass is where it opens up.

faq.title: Anomalous Coffee Machine FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Anomalous Coffee Machine.

items.question: What is Anomalous Coffee Machine?
items.answer: Anomalous Coffee Machine is a short indie visual novel with interactive simulation elements by HoruBrain. You serve a mysterious girl, type words and ingredients into an unusual machine, and watch each choice change her reaction and the ending you reach.

items.question: Where can I play Anomalous Coffee Machine?
items.answer: Anomalous Coffee Machine is distributed through the developer's official itch.io page, where you can play the current build in a browser or download it for desktop.

items.question: How do you play Anomalous Coffee Machine?
items.answer: Anomalous Coffee Machine plays as a short, repeatable loop: read the scene, choose a response, brew a cup, and watch the girl react. Observation matters far more than reflexes, so slow the text speed and pay attention to pauses and tone shifts.

items.question: How many words and transformations does Anomalous Coffee Machine have?
items.answer: Anomalous Coffee Machine currently lists 700+ words, 600+ transformations, 200+ animated scenes, and 100,000+ dialogue words, so there is far more to discover than a single playthrough reveals.

items.question: How do I unlock every ending in Anomalous Coffee Machine?
items.answer: Anomalous Coffee Machine fills your gallery as you play, so keep at least two save slots, re-test combos after each update, and treat every ending — including the abrupt failures — as a step toward full completion.

items.question: Does Anomalous Coffee Machine get updates?
items.answer: Yes. Anomalous Coffee Machine receives content updates that add new drink combinations, dialogue branches, endings, and gallery slots, so re-check solved recipes and early scenes after each patch.
